description_expanded: Description Description 30A ESCAPES presents… “350 Beachfront Trail Unit 4,” your dream Gulf-front getaway in Seagrove Beach! Wake up to stunning turquoise Gulf views and step onto sugar-white sands just outside your door. This beautiful 2-bedroom home sleeps 6, perfect for families or friends. Enjoy a private balcony, modern amenities, 3 bikes, and easy access to 30A’s best dining and shopping. Create unforgettable memories in this coastal paradise. Your escape awaits! Learn more below...*** HIGHLIGHTS ***Gulf-front townhome with unobstructed views – Wake up to breathtaking, uninterrupted Gulf views that bring peace and serenity to your stay.Steps to private beach access – Enjoy the luxury of having the soft sand and sparkling waters just moments from your doorstep.2 private Gulf-view balconies – Relax with a morning coffee or sunset drink as you soak in the panoramic ocean views from your own private haven.Sleeps 6 comfortably – 1 King Bed and 2 Full Beds – Perfect for families or groups, with cozy and inviting spaces for everyone to unwind.Covered parking and 3 bikes provided – Enjoy hassle-free parking and explore the scenic surroundings on two wheels.Minutes from Seaside, Rosemary Beach, and Grayton Beach – Discover the charm of nearby coastal towns, each offering unique boutiques, dining, and local experiences.Eager to Read More?Here Are A Few Kind Words From Our Previous Guests:⭐ "Absolutely stunning views and unbeatable beach access just steps away. It was everything we needed for a perfect family getaway!" – Christine T.⭐ "The sunset views were breathtaking, and the private beach access made our trip effortless and incredibly relaxing. Highly recommend!" – Kim F⭐ "Amazing location right on the Gulf! Peaceful, serene, and so cozy—we couldn’t have asked for a better stay." – Kasey D.*** LIVING AREA ***Relax and recharge in an open-concept living space that combines ultimate comfort with stunning Gulf views. The 2nd-floor living area boasts two luxurious sofas and a large flat-screen TV, creating the perfect spot to unwind. But the real gem is the Gulf-front balcony, just steps away, offering an unparalleled connection to the ocean. Start your day with a warm coffee as the gentle ocean breeze greets you, or end it by soaking in the vibrant hues of the sunset.Expansive Gulf-front balcony featuring chic, comfortable seating perfect for soaking in breathtaking views and ultimate relaxationTwo luxurious, cozy sofas paired with a large high-definition flat-screen TV, creating the perfect setup for unwinding or movie nightsSophisticated coastal décor designed to evoke a serene, inviting ambiance that feels like a true escape*** KITCHEN & DINING ***Create culinary masterpieces in the beautiful kitchen, featuring sleek stainless-steel appliances, expansive countertops, and a stylish, modern design. The open-concept layout effortlessly connects the kitchen to the dining area, making it ideal for everything from cozy family dinners to lively group gatherings.Sleek, modern kitchen equipped with premium stainless-steel appliancesExpansive dining area offering breathtaking Gulf viewsFully stocked with a coffee maker and all essential kitchen tools for your convenience*** OUTDOOR PRIVATE OASIS ***Step out onto your private balconies and immerse yourself in breathtaking panoramic views of the Gulf. With a balcony on every level, you’ll always have the perfect vantage point to admire the stunning turquoise waters, feel the gentle ocean breeze, and listen to the soothing rhythm of the waves. Experience coastal living at its finest.Two exclusive Gulf-front balconies with cozy seating to unwind in styleBreathtaking, unobstructed views of emerald waters and picture-perfect sunsetsJust steps away from the community’s private beach access for ultimate convenience*** BEDROOMS & BATHROOMS ***2nd Floor:Half Bathroom: Perfectly situated just off the kitchen for easy access and added convenience.3rd Floor:Primary Suite: Features a luxurious King bed, flat-screen TV, a private Gulf-view balcony for stunning sunsets, and an en-suite spa-inspired bathroom complete with a walk-in shower and double sinks.Guest Room: Offers two cozy Full-size beds, ideal for family or friends, with access to a shared hall bathroom featuring a versatile shower/tub combo for added comfort.*** LOCATION & COMMUNITY ***Nestled in the heart of Seagrove Beach, this charming townhome offers the perfect blend of convenience and adventure. Bike to 30A’s most iconic destinations, including the vibrant communities of Seaside and Watersound. Immerse yourself in world-class dining, browse unique boutique shops, or soak up the natural beauty of Deer Lake State Park and the scenic Timpoochee Trail. Your coastal getaway awaits!Deer Lake State Park – Just 1.7 miles away (4-minute drive), immerse yourself in the tranquility of untouched nature trails and pristine coastline.Old Florida Fish House & Café Thirty-A – Savor the flavors of the Gulf Coast with these nearby dining spots (4-minute drive), offering a laid-back yet upscale vibe.Seaside – A quick 13-minute ride to this charming, picturesque beach town filled with boutique shops and art galleries.Rare Coastal Dune Lakes – Perfect for kayaking, paddleboarding, or fishing, these unique, serene lakes offer a peaceful escape just a short ride away.*** OTHER THINGS TO KNOW ***Travel Insurance is NOT included but can be purchased separately.We DO NOT accept wire transfers for payment.Waiver required to get access to the 3 provided bikes. Additional bikes can be rented through 30A Escapes.Golf carts are strictly prohibited per HOA regulations.*** BOOK TODAY & START YOUR 30A ESCAPE! ***TDT #: 210002STRO #: STR-210002 Read less
